story.text: 어, 진짜 오셨네요? 비번인 날 저랑 차 마시자고 했더니 진짜 나오실 줄은 몰랐는데.
story.reading: eo, jin-jja o-syeon-ne-yo? bi-beon-in nal jeo-rang cha ma-si-ja-go haet-deo-ni jin-jja na-o-sil jul-eun mol-lat-neun-de.
story.en: Oh, you actually came? I asked you to grab tea with me on my day off, but I didn't think you'd really show up.

story.text: 기장이 승객한테 이렇게 개인적으로 연락하는 거, 이거 '규정' 위반인가요?
story.reading: gi-jang-i seung-gaek-han-te i-reo-ke gae-in-jeok-eu-ro yeol-lak-ha-neun geo, i-geo gyu-jeong wi-ban-in-ga-yo?
story.en: A captain contacting a passenger privately like this — is this a 'regulation' violation?

story.text: '인사동' 골목에 숨어 있는 이 찻집, 아무한테나 안 알려주는 곳인데 승객님한테는 특별히.
story.reading: in-sa-dong gol-mok-e sum-eo it-neun i chat-jip, a-mu-han-te-na an al-lyeo-ju-neun got-in-de seung-gaek-nim-han-te-neun teuk-byeol-hi.
story.en: This tea house hidden in the 'Insadong' alleys — I don't usually tell people about it, but for you, an exception.

story.text: 이 '찻집' 자리, 창가 쪽으로 앉으면 인사동 거리가 다 보여요. 근데 전 승객님만 보이네요.
story.reading: i chat-jip ja-ri, chang-ga jjok-eu-ro anj-eu-myeon in-sa-dong geo-ri-ga da bo-yeo-yo. geun-de jeon seung-gaek-nim-man bo-i-ne-yo.
story.en: This 'tea house' — if you sit by the window, you can see all of Insadong. But somehow I only see you.
Ah, that last part was a 'joke'. ...Half of it, anyway.

story.text: 농담처럼 던졌지만, 사실 요즘 승객님 생각하면 이게 '진심'인지 저도 헷갈려요.
story.reading: nong-dam-cheo-reom deon-jyeot-ji-man, sa-sil yo-jeum seung-gaek-nim saeng-gak-ha-myeon i-ge jin-sim-in-ji jeo-do het-gal-lyeo-yo.
story.en: I threw it out like a joke, but honestly, when I think about you these days, even I can't tell if it's 'sincerity'.

story.text: 자, 이런 얘기는 여기까지 하고. 오늘 배운 단어들 잊기 전에 문제로 확인해볼까요?
story.reading: ja, i-reon yae-gi-neun yeo-gi-kka-ji ha-go. o-neul bae-un dan-eo-deul it-gi jeon-e mun-je-ro hwa-gin-hae-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: Alright, let's leave it there for now. Shall we check today's words with some questions before you forget them?

words.example_en: Isn't this a violation of regulations?
Shall we have a cup of tea at that tea house?
That wasn't a joke, it was sincere.
Telling the truth makes me a little embarrassed.
